slides.title: Garam tawa chhua… haath pehle hata, socha baad mein 🔥
slides.sub: Reflex, instinct, Pavlov ke kutte aur behaviour ki science. 6 exam topics, 20 slides 📌

slides.title: 6 exam topics, ek post
items: Behaviour ko science kaise padhti hai

slides.title: Brain ko pata chalne se pehle haath hat gaya
items: involuntary, lagbhag instant movement, kisi stimulus par
spinal cord ke interneurons seedha motor neurons ko signal bhejte hain; brain tak message nahi jaata

slides.title: Baby survival kit ke saath paida hota hai
items: gaal chhuo → muh mudta, chusne ki koshish → feeding
tez roshni → aankh band → aankh ki safety
talve par chubhan → pair khinch → dard se door

slides.title: 4 aur reflexes, 4 kaam
items: ek taraf sir, wahi haath seedha → hand-eye coordination
hatheli mein cheez → kas ke pakadna, thodi der wazan bhi
tez awaaz ya girne ka ehsaas → haath-pair phaila ke wapas → girne se bachao
pair surface ke paas → chalne jaisi movement → motor development

slides.title: Reflex sirf shuruaat hai
items: pehle kuch mahine survive karne mein madad
fixed response; naye situations ke liye baby ko naye routines seekhne padte hain
aage ka zyada behaviour seekha hua (learned) hota hai

slides.title: Khana aaya bhi nahi, kutton ke muh mein paani kyun?
items: lab technician ko dekhte hi kutte laar tapkane lage
khane se pehle ek sound; kuch baar ke baad sirf sound par hi laar

slides.title: Seekha hua response kab mitta, kab lauta?
items: sirf sound, khana nahi → laar band
break ke baad laar phir se, thodi kam
milte-julte stimulus par bhi wahi response

slides.title: Nature ya experience? Dono!
items: gaadi chalate panic attack → driving se hi dar (driving = CS)
evolution ne kuch associations seekhna aasaan banaya

slides.title: Kuch yaad jaan-boojh ke, kuch bina jaane
items: jo hum jaan-boojh ke yaad karte hain: episodic + semantic
experience behaviour badalta hai, pata bhi nahi chalta

slides.title: Cycle chalana yaad hai, par kaise samjhaoge?
items: kaam kaise karna hai: chalna, bolna, phone dial karna
complex kaam bhi bina soche, bina explain kiye ho jaate hain

slides.title: Psychology ke 3 research designs
items: abhi kya ho raha hai: ek snapshot
do cheezein saath badalti hain? jaise height aur weight → prediction

slides.title: Independent vs dependent variable
items: shuru mein sab barabar, phir ek ko experience diya, phir measure

slides.title: Correlation hai, matlab cause nahi
items: sirf batata hai ki do cheezein judi hain
sirf experiment se pakka hota hai

slides.title: Behaviour kyun bana? Survival ke liye
items: memory, emotion, personality: sabka adaptive function
koi trait survive aur reproduce karne mein kitna madad karta hai

slides.title: Emotions humein move karte hain
items: isliye hum bachchon ki care karte hain
isliye bheed wali sadak par turn nahi lete
party miss ki, isliye dost se extra achha bartav

slides.title: Same baat, alag reaction. Kyun?
items: "You are so beautiful": koi khush, koi shak mein. Mind stimulus ko interpret karta hai
kisi cheez ke baare mein lambi rai: kuch genes se, kuch experience se

slides.title: Behaviour ka engine
items: driving force jo behaviour shuru aur direct karti hai
body ka balance bigde to andar ki push: bhookh, pyaas
jo end state hum paana chahte hain

slides.title: Ek nazar mein revision
items: spinal shortcut · newborn: rooting, blink, grasp, Moro, stepping
